description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Buff Water 20% (15s)], [Buff Earth 20% (15s)], [Buff Holy 20% (15s)], [Awoken Instacast], [Damage Cap +20000], [Tri-Element Mode II (Earth, Water, Holy)] and [Facing Destiny] to the user

description.name: Buff Water 20% (15s)
description.text: Increases Water damage dealt by 20%, cumulable

description.name: Buff Earth 20% (15s)
description.text: Increases Earth damage dealt by 20%, cumulable

description.name: Buff Holy 20% (15s)
description.text: Increases Holy damage dealt by 20%, cumulable

description.name: Awoken Instacast
description.text: Summoning abilities don't consume uses, Summoning abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, instant cast speed for Summoning abilities

description.name: Tri-Element Mode II (Earth, Water, Holy)
description.text: Grants [Attach Earth with Stacking]/[Attach Water with Stacking]/[Attach Holy with Stacking] after using a Earth/Water/Holy ability

description.name: Facing Destiny
description.text: Casts Mist Strike when Awoken Instacast is removed, removed after triggering
